desc: Opening. The Mirzapur mela at blue hour: ferris wheel, stalls, thousands of people. Camera drifts in over the lights toward the crowd.
mov: Drone push in + slow tilt down
notes: Super: GHANTA 00 (timestamp style used through the film). Mixed sodium + LED fairy-light palette. Sets scale before we go small.
audio: VO: 'Shaam ke 7 baj rahe the.' + mela ambience
scene: Scene 1 - PART 1: MELA (Ghanta 00) - EXT. Mirzapur Mela - Night, 7 PM

desc: Dense crowd compressed through the ferris wheel spokes; heads, balloons, food smoke.
notes: Long-lens compression = claustrophobia. Plant red balloons in frame, but not dominant yet.
audio: VO: 'Mirzapur ke mele mein chaaron taraf bas bheed hi bheed thi.'
scene: Scene 1 - PART 1: MELA (Ghanta 00) - EXT. Mirzapur Mela - Night, 7 PM

desc: The Gupta family (parents + kids) walking through the stalls, laughing, eating.
mov: Gimbal follow from behind, arcs to frontal
notes: Warm, happy grade. This is the last 'normal' moment of the film.
audio: VO: 'Isi bheed mein Gupta family bhi thi...'
scene: Scene 1 - PART 1: MELA (Ghanta 00) - EXT. Mirzapur Mela - Night, 7 PM

desc: Dhruv (8) holding father's finger, blue jacket, zip held shut with a safety pin.
notes: IMPORTANT PLANT: the safety pin on the zip must be visible here. Pays off in Shot 78.
audio: VO: 'Aur unhi bachchon mein tha 8 saal ka Dhruv.'
scene: Scene 1 - PART 1: MELA (Ghanta 00) - EXT. Mirzapur Mela - Night, 7 PM

desc: Dhruv's POV: a cluster of balloons on a vendor's pole across the crowd. One red balloon catches the light.
mov: Static, rack focus crowd to balloons
notes: The red balloon is the film's motif. Keep it the only saturated red in frame.
audio: Ambience, crowd dips slightly
scene: Scene 1 - PART 1: MELA (Ghanta 00) - EXT. Mirzapur Mela - Night, 7 PM

desc: Dhruv tugging mother's dupatta, pointing, pleading. Parents are busy bargaining at a stall.
notes: Parents' faces cut off by the frame top: to Dhruv they are unreachable.
audio: VO: 'Blue jacket pehne Dhruv pichhle aadhe ghante se balloon lene ki zid kar raha tha.'
scene: Scene 1 - PART 1: MELA (Ghanta 00) - EXT. Mirzapur Mela - Night, 7 PM

desc: Dhruv's hand slowly slips out of his father's hand.
notes: The inciting moment. Hold the empty hand for a beat after.
audio: VO: 'Jab kisi ne uski baat nahi suni...'
scene: Scene 1 - PART 1: MELA (Ghanta 00) - EXT. Mirzapur Mela - Night, 7 PM

desc: Parents soft in the foreground, still bargaining. In the background Dhruv walks away and the crowd swallows him.
notes: Deep staging. Focus stays on Dhruv, parents unaware in the foreground.
audio: VO: '...to woh chupchaap balloon lene khud chala gaya.'
scene: Scene 1 - PART 1: MELA (Ghanta 00) - EXT. Mirzapur Mela - Night, 7 PM

desc: Speed ramp: the crowd blurs, then snaps to normal speed. Mother turns, smile fading, looks down beside her. Empty.
notes: Super: +10 MIN. SFX: heartbeat thump on the rack.
audio: VO: 'Kareeb 10 minute baad gharwalon ko jab wo kahin nahi dikha...'
scene: Scene 1 - PART 1: MELA (Ghanta 00) - EXT. Mirzapur Mela - Night, 7 PM

desc: Family scatters in different directions through the crowd, seen from above.
notes: Four figures splitting apart like a crack.
audio: VO: 'To unhe laga kisi jhoole ya dukaan ke paas ruk gaya hoga. Sab alag-alag taraf dhoondhne lage.'
scene: Scene 1 - PART 1: MELA (Ghanta 00) - EXT. Mirzapur Mela - Night, 7 PM

desc: Quick inserts: father at the jhoola, mother at the toy stall, uncle near the food carts, each calling out 'Dhruv!'
notes: Fast cutting. Lose the geography on purpose; build panic.
audio: VO: 'Par Dhruv nahi mila.' + parents calling 'Dhruv!'
scene: Scene 1 - PART 1: MELA (Ghanta 00) - EXT. Mirzapur Mela - Night, 7 PM

desc: Parents reach the balloon seller. Balloons frame the foreground.
notes: Seller half-hidden by his own balloons (quiet foreshadow; he is the suspect).
audio: VO: 'Dhoondhte-dhoondhte Dhruv ke maa-baap ek balloon bechne wale ke paas pahunche.'
scene: Scene 1 - PART 1: MELA (Ghanta 00) - EXT. Mirzapur Mela - Night, 7 PM

desc: Father, breathless, asks the seller.
audio: Father: 'Bhaiya, blue jacket pehne ek chhota bachcha yahan aaya tha kya?'
scene: Scene 1 - PART 1: MELA (Ghanta 00) - EXT. Mirzapur Mela - Night, 7 PM

desc: Balloon seller answers quickly and confidently, pointing toward the gate.
notes: He answers too fast. Play it neutral; the audience should not suspect him yet.
audio: Seller: 'Haan. Abhi kuch der pehle aaya tha. Lekin balloon lene se pehle do aadmi uske paas aaye...'
scene: Scene 1 - PART 1: MELA (Ghanta 00) - EXT. Mirzapur Mela - Night, 7 PM

desc: RECREATION (seller's version): two men approach Dhruv, one thin with a black cap hands him a red balloon; they lead him to a white van. Faces never shown, backs and silhouettes only.
notes: 'Told' grade: desaturated, slight frame blur. Mirrored later in Shot 152 with the TRUE version.
audio: Seller (cont., as VO): '...Unhone use red balloon diya, white van mein bithaya... aur us gate se nikal gaye.'
scene: Scene 1 - PART 1: MELA (Ghanta 00) - EXT. Mirzapur Mela - Night, 7 PM

desc: Father's face, sweat, the words landing. Mother's hand grips his arm.
audio: VO: 'Dhruv ke pita ke is ek sawal ke unhe 5 jawab mile. Aur jawab bhi aise the ki sun kar dono ke pasine chhoot gaye.'
scene: Scene 1 - PART 1: MELA (Ghanta 00) - EXT. Mirzapur Mela - Night, 7 PM

desc: Crane up off the parents into the night sky; VFX map zoom-out from the mela to Mirzapur to UP to Lucknow HQ.
mov: Crane up into VFX map zoom
notes: Map style reused for every level of the hierarchy. Keep one consistent map graphic system.
audio: VO: 'Par ye dar sirf Gupta family tak rukne wala nahi tha. Mela Chowki ke Constable se lekar Lucknow mein baithe DGP tak - Dhruv ki talaash Police system ke har level ko hilane wali thi.'
scene: Scene 1 - PART 1: MELA (Ghanta 00) - EXT. Mirzapur Mela - Night, 7 PM

desc: Macro montage of uniform details: shoulder stars, Ashoka emblem, belt buckle, name plate, badges. Graphic ladder of ranks builds up the screen.
notes: Dark background, hard rim light on the metal. Question text appears on screen: SHO? IO? CO?
audio: VO: 'Isliye hamare liye ye sirf kidnapping ka case nahi hai... SHO, IO, CO - ye ranks hain ya kuch aur?'
scene: Scene 1 - PART 1: MELA (Ghanta 00) - EXT. Mirzapur Mela - Night, 7 PM

desc: TITLE: a single red balloon rises into the black sky. Title OPERATION RED BALLOON with RED in red.
mov: Static, balloon rises out of frame
notes: Title card. Music hit on the title.
audio: VO: 'Aur seedhi mein sabse upar pahunch kar hum is ek sawal ka jawab dhoondhenge, ki Police mein sabse powerful kaun hai.'
scene: Scene 1 - PART 1: MELA (Ghanta 00) - EXT. Mirzapur Mela - Night, 7 PM

desc: Parents and the balloon seller hurry up to the small mela chowki booth. Constable Ravi stands outside with a lathi and wireless.
notes: Super: GHANTA 00:20.
audio: VO: 'Dhruv ke parents balloon wale ko lekar paas ki Mela Chowki pahunchte hai.'
scene: Scene 2 - PART 2: GROUND (Ghanta 00:20) - EXT. Mela Chowki - Night

desc: Ravi turns toward them. 0.5s freeze with the lower-third graphic.
notes: Lower third: [RANK: CONSTABLE | ROLE: MELA DUTY]. Keep this lower-third template for every officer.
audio: VO: 'Aur bahar unhe milta hai Police system ka pehla common chehra - Constable Ravi.'
scene: Scene 2 - PART 2: GROUND (Ghanta 00:20) - EXT. Mela Chowki - Night

desc: Father pleading with Ravi, mother behind him.
notes: Two-shot.
audio: Father: 'Sir, hamara beta nahi mil raha. Ye bhaiya keh rahe hain do log use van mein lekar chale gaye.'
scene: Scene 2 - PART 2: GROUND (Ghanta 00:20) - EXT. Mela Chowki - Night

desc: Ravi, calm and immediate.
notes: No hesitation; he acts before he thinks about hierarchy.
audio: Ravi: 'Photo WhatsApp kariye.'
scene: Scene 2 - PART 2: GROUND (Ghanta 00:20) - EXT. Mela Chowki - Night

desc: Phone screen: Dhruv's photo in the blue jacket arrives on WhatsApp.
notes: Screen insert. SFX: WhatsApp ping.
audio: SFX ping
scene: Scene 2 - PART 2: GROUND (Ghanta 00:20) - EXT. Mela Chowki - Night

desc: Ravi questions the seller in rapid fire; seller points to the lane and the gate.
notes: Quick cutting on each question.
audio: VO/Ravi: 'Gaadi kaunsi thi? Colour kya tha? Kahan se nikal ke gayi?'
scene: Scene 2 - PART 2: GROUND (Ghanta 00:20) - EXT. Mela Chowki - Night

desc: Ravi presses the wireless PTT and speaks. Insert of the radio grille.
audio: Wireless (Ravi): 'Constable Ravi bol raha hoon, shayad ek 8 saal ka ladka kidnap hua hai... Sabko bacche ki Photo forward kar raha hoon.'
scene: Scene 2 - PART 2: GROUND (Ghanta 00:20) - EXT. Mela Chowki - Night

desc: Montage: constables across the mela get the message. Phones light up, radios crackle, heads snap around.
notes: 4-5 constables in 4-5 locations (gate, parking, jhoola, food lane).
audio: VO: 'Kuch hi seconds mein Dhruv ki photo aur gaadi ki details mele ke sare constables tak pahunch chuki thi.'
scene: Scene 2 - PART 2: GROUND (Ghanta 00:20) - EXT. Mela Chowki - Night

desc: Top-down mela map (VFX): constables light up as glowing dots and start moving. No senior officer icon anywhere.
mov: Drone top down with VFX overlay
audio: VO: 'Abhi tak case me koi senior officer shaamil nahi hua tha. Na FIR likhi gayi thi na investigation shuru hui thi. Par zameen par police harkat me a chuki thi.'
scene: Scene 2 - PART 2: GROUND (Ghanta 00:20) - EXT. Mela Chowki - Night

desc: GRAPHIC: GOLDEN HOURS. A golden clock or hourglass starts draining. SP and DGP icons fade out, the constable icon glows.
notes: Gold is the colour for 'time pressure' throughout.
audio: VO: 'Reason tha Golden Hours... Aur inhi golden hours mein sabse kaam ki rank SP ya DGP nahi, Constable hoti hai.'
scene: Scene 2 - PART 2: GROUND (Ghanta 00:20) - EXT. Mela Chowki - Night

desc: GRAPHIC: the POWER METER is introduced. Five bars appear one by one with labels.
notes: Master power-meter template, reused for every officer.
audio: VO: 'Isliye aaj hum sirf ranks ko dekhenge nahi... RESPONSE, DECISION, INVESTIGATION, COMMAND, REACH...'
scene: Scene 2 - PART 2: GROUND (Ghanta 00:20) - EXT. Mela Chowki - Night

desc: Freeze on Ravi on his radio, power meter fills beside him. Map inset: MELA GROUND.
notes: R5 D1 I1 C0 Reach1.
audio: VO: 'Ab isi basis pe Constable Ravi ka meter dekhiye.'
scene: Scene 2 - PART 2: GROUND (Ghanta 00:20) - EXT. Mela Chowki - Night

desc: Ravi pushes into the chowki.
notes: Inside: a single tube light, tin walls, mela noise muffled.
audio: VO: 'Wireless message ke baad Constable Ravi seedha Chowki ke andar chala gaya. Kyunki response to shuru ho chuka tha. Ab zarurat thi use organise karne ki.'
scene: Scene 3 - PART 2 (cont.): INT. Mela Chowki - Night

desc: Head Constable Mishra at a desk with a wireless set; a hand-drawn mela map pinned on the wall behind.
notes: Lower third: [RANK: HEAD CONSTABLE | ROLE: CHOWKI DUTY].
audio: VO: 'Poora mela ek hi chowki ke under ata tha. Aur us chowki par the Head Constable Mishra.'
scene: Scene 3 - PART 2 (cont.): INT. Mela Chowki - Night

desc: Mishra gives orders on the wireless. Intercut his finger tapping points on the map: exit gate, parking, jhoole.
notes: Each map tap is on a word of dialogue.
audio: Wireless (Mishra): 'Exit gate ki checking badhao... Aur Ravi, tum Parents aur witness ko Police Station lekar jao.'
scene: Scene 3 - PART 2 (cont.): INT. Mela Chowki - Night

desc: Montage of the orders being carried out: gate checking, two constables in the parking CCTV room, Kapil and Sneha searching stalls, Ravi guiding parents to the jeep.
notes: One shot per order, in the order he gives them.
audio: Music + ambience
scene: Scene 3 - PART 2 (cont.): INT. Mela Chowki - Night

desc: Split screen: Ravi on the radio (left) vs Mishra at the map (right).
notes: Labels: REACTION vs PLAN.
audio: VO: 'Ab dekhiye, Constable Ravi ka response ghatna pe hue reaction jaisa tha. Par wahin Head Constable ka response ek plan jaisa tha.'
scene: Scene 3 - PART 2 (cont.): INT. Mela Chowki - Night

desc: Power meter for Mishra. Map inset: MELA CHOWKI.
notes: R5 D2 I1 C2 Reach1.
audio: VO: 'Aur ye unke Meter mein bhi dikhta hai.'
scene: Scene 3 - PART 2 (cont.): INT. Mela Chowki - Night

desc: Police jeep with the parents and seller pulls out of the mela, red-blue lights on the crowd.
audio: VO: 'Head Constable jante the ki sirf mele mein dhoondhna kaafi nahi tha... Taaki investigation sahi tareeke se agey badh paye.'
scene: Scene 3 - PART 2 (cont.): INT. Mela Chowki - Night

desc: Police station exterior at night; the jeep arrives.
notes: Super: GHANTA 01:00. Cold tube-light and sodium look from here on.
audio: VO: 'Dhruv ke parents aur balloon wala Police Station pahunchte hain.'
scene: Scene 4 - PART 3: PROCESS (Ghanta 01:00) - INT. Police Station, Duty Desk - Night

desc: ASI Aditi at the duty desk, register open.
notes: Lower third: [RANK: ASI | ROLE: DUTY DESK].
audio: VO: 'Jahan Duty desk par unhe milti hai Assistant Sub-Inspector Aditi.'
scene: Scene 4 - PART 3: PROCESS (Ghanta 01:00) - INT. Police Station, Duty Desk - Night

desc: Aditi questions the seller.
notes: Hold on the seller a beat after 'Bachcha khud gaya'. That is the first crack in his story.
audio: Aditi/Seller: 'Bachcha balloon lene aaya tha?' 'Haan madam.' 'Phir?' 'Do aadmi aaye...' 'Zabardasti?' 'Nahi madam. Bachcha khud gaya...'
scene: Scene 4 - PART 3: PROCESS (Ghanta 01:00) - INT. Police Station, Duty Desk - Night

desc: Mother leans in and asks; Aditi answers firmly.
notes: Myth-buster moment: can be flagged with an on-screen text tag.
audio: Mother: 'Report abhi ho jayegi na?...' / Aditi: 'Ji, baccho ke case mein aisa nahi hota. FIR abhi register hogi.'
scene: Scene 4 - PART 3: PROCESS (Ghanta 01:00) - INT. Police Station, Duty Desk - Night

desc: FIR being written and stamped; FIR number filled in.
notes: SFX: stamp thud.
audio: VO: 'ASI Aditi ne turant FIR register kar li. Lekin FIR to bas pehla step tha.'
scene: Scene 4 - PART 3: PROCESS (Ghanta 01:00) - INT. Police Station, Duty Desk - Night

desc: Slow push in on the FIR page while question cards appear: WITNESS? CCTV? VAN? IO?
audio: VO: 'Iske baad ek bada decision hona tha - Witness ko detail mein kaun examine karega?... is case ka Investigating Officer kaun hoga?'
scene: Scene 4 - PART 3: PROCESS (Ghanta 01:00) - INT. Police Station, Duty Desk - Night

desc: Aditi on the phone to Inspector Khan. Intercut Khan from behind or in silhouette at another crime scene.
notes: Keep Khan's face hidden until Part 5; he is 'the voice of command'.
audio: Aditi: 'Sir, child kidnapping ka case lag raha hai...' / Khan: 'Sub-Inspector Pandey ko bulao. Wahi case investigate karenge...'
scene: Scene 4 - PART 3: PROCESS (Ghanta 01:00) - INT. Police Station, Duty Desk - Night

desc: Freeze on Aditi hanging up; power meter. Map inset: POLICE STATION PROCESS.
notes: R4 D2 I2 C1 Reach1.
audio: VO: 'Aditi ne yahan koi case solve nahi kiya. Usne bas Dhruv ko ek missing bacche se ek registered case me badal diya.'
scene: Scene 4 - PART 3: PROCESS (Ghanta 01:00) - INT. Police Station, Duty Desk - Night

desc: Father asks to speak to the Inspector; Aditi explains.
notes: The father's frustration is the audience's question.
audio: Father: 'Madam, Inspector sahab se baat kara dijiye.' / Aditi: 'Sir se abhi baat hui hai... aapke bete ka case Pandey sir dekhenge.'
scene: Scene 4 - PART 3: PROCESS (Ghanta 01:00) - INT. Police Station, Duty Desk - Night

desc: GRAPHIC: RANK vs POST. Inspector stars on one side, the 'SHO' nameplate on the other.
notes: Same text treatment reused later for SI/IO, DSP/CO and SP/District Chief.
audio: VO: 'Yahin ek chhota sa confusion clear kar lete hain... Aur post batati hai is waqt uske pass kya responsibility hai.'
scene: Scene 4 - PART 3: PROCESS (Ghanta 01:00) - INT. Police Station, Duty Desk - Night

desc: Seller, unprompted, offers to stay at the station.
notes: Subtle: too helpful. The slow push quietly marks him. Don't underline with music.
audio: Seller: 'Madam, main yahin ruk jaata hoon. Bacche ka milna zaruri hai.'
scene: Scene 4 - PART 3: PROCESS (Ghanta 01:00) - INT. Police Station, Duty Desk - Night

desc: Aditi nods. Behind her, the mother sits on the wooden bench.
notes: PLANT: the bench and the mother's position. Reused in Shots 77 and 143.
audio: VO: 'ASI Aditi ko bhi baat sahi lagi... Par ab is case ka asli test shuru hone wala tha.'
scene: Scene 4 - PART 3: PROCESS (Ghanta 01:00) - INT. Police Station, Duty Desk - Night
